SELECT
ROUND(AVG(overall_rating),1) AS overallRating,
COUNT(*) AS reviewCount,
ROUND(AVG(career_growth_rating),1) AS careerGrowthRating,
ROUND(AVG(work_satisfaction_rating),1) AS workSatisfactionRating,
ROUND(AVG(compensation_rating),1) AS compensationRating,
ROUND(AVG(culture_rating),1) AS cultureRating,
SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 5 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating5Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 4 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating4Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating3Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating2Count, SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(overall_rating) = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS rating1Count
FROM company_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status='정상'

SELECT
company_review_id, company_id, author_user_id, eligibility_application_id,
employment_status, job_category_id,
career_growth_rating, work_satisfaction_rating, compensation_rating, culture_rating,
overall_rating,
pros, cons, summary,
status,
hidden_reason, hidden_by,
created_at, updated_at
FROM company_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status='정상'
ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM company_reviews
WHERE company_id = #{companyId} AND status='정상'
